title: UNI
paper_title: Towards a General-Purpose Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
core_mech: 在超过一亿病理图块上以 DINOv2 式 teacher–student 训练 ViT-L/16，向多类病理任务提供统一冻结 tile encoder。
core_mech_en: ViT-L/16 tile encoder pretrained via DINOv2 self-distillation and iBOT masked patch modeling on over 100 million H&E histopathology patches (Mass-100K).
input_desc: 全视野病理切片切出的无标签组织图块
input_en: 256×256 H&E histopathology tissue tiles extracted from whole-slide images (WSIs)
output_desc: 可冻结迁移的病理图块表征及其下游切片级聚合
output_en: Frozen transferable tile embeddings for ROI tasks or MIL whole-slide aggregation
